name: 87102 · Albuquerque, NM
findings: ZIP 87102 (Albuquerque) has 200 nonprofit organizations. 100 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 87102 (Albuquerque) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 87102 (Albuquerque) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
